card.name: Word after a noun, before 'its' part
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs right after a noun naming an object, where the next phrase describes a part or feature of that object (e.g. 'the top', 'its interior', 'it').

modes.label: Linking word after object noun
modes.description: A word such as that, from, across or of follows an object noun and leads into where something sits on that object.
modes.example: citing items such as dog food bags that have a strip of paper<< across>> the top and a pull string for opening

modes.label: Verb or participle describing a feature
modes.description: A verb after an object noun introduces something placed on or in the object.
modes.example: send them in a zipped plastic bag with holes<< punched>> in the top for air movement

modes.label: Role or membership phrase
modes.description: A word after a named person or group, introducing a role or member status.
modes.example: the Rev. Mr. Barton<< as>> pastor

card.writes: It raises words like 'its' and 'it's' (English and Chinese), pointing to a possessive reference back to the object just named.
card.plain: It fires on small words after an object noun when the text is about to refer to a part of that object, such as 'its top'.
